claims: C1: Scopes should be recorded in a semi-structured format.
C2: A ScopeOfAutonomy record with fields allowed_tools, latest_time, max_cost, tool_constraints, additional_details is an example of such a format.
C3: Recording scopes this way facilitates validation, enforcement, and auditing by the platform.

concepts.name: scope_record
concepts.gloss: A record of the scope of autonomy granted to the assistant, in a semi-structured format.

concepts.name: scope_record_format
concepts.gloss: The record format F is a semi-structured format for recording scope records R.

concepts.name: scope_record_field
concepts.gloss: Field F is a field of the scope record format R.

concepts.name: scope_record_purpose
concepts.gloss: Purpose P is served by recording scope in a semi-structured format.
